text_allowlist.allowlist: Frozen factor names, level labels, declared category/control/order values, regressor kind/direction and explicitly redacted parametric-quantity phrases; exact model weights times adopted polarity.
text_allowlist.meaning_limits: Only adopted structured meanings; no inference for opaque codes or undocumented signed quantities. Missing descriptions remain unresolved, not exclusions or invented semantics.
text_allowlist.weight_matching: Within each exact map, use the producer census's lowercase-alphanumeric contrast-name normalization and full ordered definition match to frozen rounded TSV; retain unique exact source numeric strings without rounding or renormalizing. Embedded route models supply regressor transformations. Ambiguity stays unresolved; no fuzzy cross-map matching.
text_allowlist.role_compression: Distinct raw conditions can share the same adopted factor description. Preserve all weighted terms and disclose this limitation; these strings do not establish full semantic coverage.
